## Description

Uses inflation level/change or inflation surprise to rotate among equities, nominal bonds, TIPS, commodities and other real assets.

## Where it may fit

Shifts between disinflation, reflation and inflation shocks; depends on asset sensitivities and valuation starting points.

## Vehicles

Global macro, multi-asset, tactical allocation and risk-parity portfolios.

## Required data

CPI/PCE and expectations data, release timestamps, real/nominal yields, asset total returns, commodity indices and portfolio constraints.

## Caveats

Macro regimes are estimated with revisions and delays; avoid look-ahead and test robustness to thresholds and alternate inflation measures.
